content: Silence is the safest ornament of the ignorant in an assembly of the wise.
author: Sanskrit Subhashitas
sourceWork: Swacchandam-ekantamukham (स्वायत्तमेकान्तगुणं विधात्रा विनिर्मितं छादनमज्ञतायाः) — Niti Shataka
explanation: Nature granted every human being an invincible shield against making a fool of themselves: the power to keep their mouth shut. When surrounded by masters of a craft, the wise student listens in silent reverence, absorbing gold rather than broadcasting tin.
practicalInsight: In discussions outside your core expertise today, resist the urge to offer an opinion. Listen intently and learn.
reflectionPrompt: Do you feel uncomfortable remaining silent in meetings, feeling a compulsive need to prove you have something to say?
